text:
Maya: Heads-up — staging linkcheck is failing for the migration guide. I think a heading in MDX produced a weird anchor.
Sam: Can you paste the linkcheck output?
Maya: Sure, here's the error from linkcheck:
```
ERROR: broken fragment in /guides/migration.html: missing fragment '#migration-guide'
Link: /guides/migration/#migration-guide/
Resolved anchor: migration-guide\/ (not found)
```
Leo: That looks like the slugify added a trailing slash because of the emoji in the heading. MDX slug generation can differ between build and linkcheck.
Jen: Quick fixes: either remove the emoji or give the heading an explicit id. Adding an explicit id is safer.
Maya: Example patch to make the id deterministic:
```
### Migration guide :sparkles: {#migration-guide}
```
Sam: Thanks — can you open a tiny PR with that change and the linkcheck command you ran?
Maya: Done: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9834 — small heading change + note in the PR description with `yarn docs:linkcheck` output.
docs-bot: Deploy preview for PR #9834 is ready: https://deploy.preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-9834 :rocket:
Jen: I pulled the preview and ran `yarn docs:linkcheck` locally against the preview — all fragments pass now.
Maya: Great, merging the PR now. :tada:
Leo: Follow-up: add a unit test in the docs toolchain to assert generated slugs don't include trailing slashes for headings with emoji.
Maya: Filed follow-up issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/197
Maya: Closing thread — thanks everyone! :pray:
